description.default: Auto-number figures, tables and equations, then refresh cross-references about 1.5s after you stop typing. Captions are centered with a faint tint. Equation blocks are updated in place on data-content only, so formulas are never wiped. Deleted a figure or table by mistake? Ctrl+Alt+Z rebuilds the deleted blocks with their original block IDs, so every cross-reference reconnects on its own (dead references are no longer painted red or burnt to text by default). Built-in undo stack (Ctrl+Alt+Z / Ctrl+Alt+Y, 10 runs by default, survives restart) because SiYuan's own Ctrl+Z does not capture API writes. Slash command /xref inserts a live block reference; custom hotkeys supported.
description.zh-CN: 自动重排图、表、公式编号并同步刷新交叉引用；写完题注停手约 1.5 秒自动生效。图/表题注自动居中并加一层浅底色（深浅可调）。公式只改 data-content 上的编号，不重建块，公式正文绝不会丢；空公式不编号。正在输入公式或代码时整轮跳过并自动补一轮重试，不会一次被打断就再也不排。误删图/表后按 Ctrl+Alt+Z，插件会把删掉的块按原块 ID 重建回来，指向它的交叉引用自动接上（默认不再把死链涂红或转成文本）。插件自带撤销栈，Ctrl+Alt+Z 撤回上一轮重排、Ctrl+Alt+Y 重做，默认保留 10 轮、跨重启有效。编辑器内输入 /xref 插入引用。支持自定义快捷键。
